name: superflat-passive-census
about: [проверить] Fresh isolated 26.1.2 flat saves, no other non-spectator players. Spectator checks a fresh area for chunk-generation animals, then creative observes an elevated common grass pad. Cumulative scoreboard counts after 400 and 800 enabled spawning ticks estimate the passive spawn rate; repeat fresh areas/seeds for statistics (a zero sample is valid). Spawning stops at tick 860 before the final census. 880 recording ticks plus 13 tail ticks = 44.65 seconds, leaving about 75 seconds of the bot.js 120000 ms process deadline for login, calibration, setup and cleanup. No extended timeout. Pad Y=192 keeps natural ground outside the 128-block spawn radius on both flat layouts (ours Y=0, vanilla Y=-61). The initial spectator census remains at Y=80 with radius 192 so it can see either ground; pad samples use radius 128. Restore previous gamerules manually if different.
